description: Price an instant checkout for one listing. This does not charge the card. When the signed-in buyer has a saved card and the total is under US$1,000, the result is a summary (items, shipping, total, seller) plus a confirmation_token. Call confirm_purchase with that token and payment.saved_card true to charge the saved card. If there is no saved card, or the card needs authentication (including charges of US$1,000 or more), the result includes the existing checkout link instead. The listing's seller sells the goods. ForthClear runs the marketplace and Stripe processes the payment. buyer_email is required. quantity must be a positive integer below the listing's quote threshold (quote_quantity_threshold from get_product_details). A threshold of 1 means no quantity can be bought instantly. Use request_quote. The listing must have instant checkout and a shipping price. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:purchase). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731. productId, id, and slug are aliases.

slug.description: Alias for product_id. Public listing slug.
